1Sidebar navigation — inactive item colour fails AA contrastSCOPE: GLOBALBlockerNMB-GLOBAL-001
Responsive & A11y  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Inactive nav items are Neutral/Source #1f2937 on white (15.9:1). The active item is Primary/Source #003366.
BUILD — LIVE
Inactive nav items compute to #9ca3af on #ffffff — a contrast ratio of 2.54:1, below the WCAG 2.1 AA minimum of 4.5:1 for body text. Measured on 488 nav links across every authenticated screen; opacity is 1 and pointer-events are auto, so this is the intended resting style, not a disabled state.
FIX
Set inactive sidebar links to Neutral/Source #1f2937 (or Neutral/600 #4b5563 at minimum, 7.0:1). Reserve #9ca3af for genuinely disabled items, which must also carry aria-disabled.

1GIGW masthead accessibility toolset reduced and relocated to a floating widgetSCOPE: GLOBALBlockerNMB-GLOBAL-002
Responsive & A11y  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
The government masthead carries the mandated inline toolset: A− / A / A+ text sizing, a contrast toggle, an accessibility (person) icon, and a labelled 'English ▾' language selector with a globe icon.
BUILD — LIVE
The masthead keeps A− / A / A+ and the contrast toggle but drops the accessibility icon, and the language selector is reduced to an unlabelled glyph. The accessibility options are moved into a floating circular widget pinned bottom-right (#9161ff, radius 70px).
FIX
Restore the full inline toolset in the masthead per GIGW, and trigger the accessibility panel from the masthead's accessibility icon rather than a floating button. Give the language selector a visible label.

1Filter controls built as rectangular selects instead of the designed filter pillsMajorNMB-PLEDGE-001
Components & States
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Filters are pill-shaped buttons with a leading chevron and a rounded 8px radius — 'All District ▾', 'Uttar Pradesh ▾' and a 'Date Range' button with a calendar icon.
BUILD — LIVE
Filters render as rectangular native-style select boxes plus a separate date-range input, in a different control family from the design.
FIX
Rebuild the filter row with the designed pill control (8px radius, chevron affordance, Noto Sans 14px) so filters read as one component family across list screens.
2Danger red used for the non-destructive Clear-Filters controlMajorNMB-PLEDGE-002
Color & Token
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
No danger-coloured control appears in the filter row; clearing filters is a neutral, low-emphasis action.
BUILD — LIVE
The clear-filters control is rendered in Danger red (#d64539 family, 50 elements across 5 screens), which signals a destructive action to the user.
FIX
Restyle clear-filters as a neutral tertiary control; reserve Danger/Source for genuinely destructive actions such as delete.
3Pagination loses its previous/next affordanceMinorNMB-PLEDGE-003
Components & States
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Pagination reads '‹ 1 2 3 4 5 6 … 150 ›' with chevron previous and next controls at each end.
BUILD — LIVE
Pagination renders '1 2 3 … 3,19,399 +' — the chevrons are replaced by a '+' glyph and there is no previous control.
FIX
Restore the chevron previous/next controls and the truncated page range per the design.

3KPI cards lost their trend indicatorMajorNMB-SNODASH-003
Components & States
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Each KPI card carries a value and a trend line beneath it — an up/down arrow with '+14.5% vs last month' in Success or Danger.
BUILD — LIVE
KPI cards render the label, icon and value only; no trend line appears on any card.
FIX
Restore the trend row on each KPI card using Text/Success #2e7d32 and Text/Error #ec5042 for positive and negative deltas.
4KPI grid reflows to unequal card widthsMinorNMB-SNODASH-004
Layout & Spacing
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT

FIX
Lay the KPI row out on a uniform grid so every card shares one column width and the last row aligns to the same tracks.

1Page title (H1) is off the type scale and inconsistent between screensSCOPE: GLOBALMajorNMB-GLOBAL-004
Typography  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
One page-title role: Headline/headline-3 — 24px, SemiBold (600), Neutral/Source #1f2937. The NAPDDR screens use Display/display-5 — 28px, Medium.
BUILD — LIVE
Four different treatments across the build: 24px/600/#111827, 24px/700/#374151, 24px/600/#1f2937 and 32px/600/#374151. Neither #111827 nor #374151 is a token in the NMBA palette.
FIX
Bind every page title to one token — font-size 24px, weight 600, colour #1f2937 — and use 28px Medium only where the design specifies Display/display-5.

1Corner-radius drift across buttons and controlsSCOPE: GLOBALMinorNMB-GLOBAL-008
Layout & Spacing  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
button-corner = 8px; the radius ramp is 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 999.
BUILD — LIVE
Alongside the 8px token (1,745 controls) the build also renders radius 12 (924), 0 (839), 10 (47), 6 (11) and 70 (66). Radius 10 alone appears on 310 elements across all 36 screens; 10 and 70 are not on the ramp at all.
FIX
Bind control radii to the token ramp — 8px for buttons and inputs, 12px for cards — and replace the 10px and 70px values with radius-md/radius-lg or radius-full.

Deferred — by decision

6 Parked
NMB-SCOPE-001Patient Data Monitoring System (IRCA / ODIC / CPLI / PDMS-Admin) — 88 design frames
Designed module with no corresponding routes on the dev build.
NMB-SCOPE-00218 August National Pledge Against Drug Abuse Report — 39 design frames
Designed reporting flow (Block / District / State / Line Ministries / Spiritual Orgs / HEI / GIA); not built on this environment.
NMB-SCOPE-003MV / Institutions role — 11 design frames
No login was supplied for this role, so the build could not be captured.
NMB-SCOPE-004e-Pledge OTP + certificate states
OTP-gated. Per audit policy a real OTP is never fired on dev; the form was filled with dummy data and captured up to the OTP wall.
NMB-SCOPE-005Citizen Helpline screen
Designed (National De-Addiction Helpline 14446 + call statistics); no /helpline route exists on the build.
NMB-SCOPE-006Row-level detail views and committee record states
The dev database has no seeded committee records ('No committees found'), so row chips, badges and detail drawers cannot be exercised.
